key_findings: Kaempferol relieved CCI neuropathic pain and lowered TLR4, NF-kB p65 and proinflammatory cytokines including PGE2.
In LPS-treated BV2 cells kaempferol blocked TLR4/NF-kB and MAPK activation and shifted M1 to M2.
